question: Who wins the Kansas Senate race in 2026
quote: I'm not sanguine about my pick because there are so many political professionals who think I'm wrong on this one, but I'm going to give it to Marshall as another hold.
turn_text: Well, it's not our last race, but it is up there. I mean, recently, and you've probably all heard it, there's been this cacophony of loud noises from political professionals and political reporters saying that this one is going to fall to the challenger, Adam Hamilson. He's given Marshall a run for his money. And as Jim said, it's been a very maladroit candidate, including that one ad where apparently he went over the heads of his own campaign team. Very bad practice. Nevertheless, because I'm defaulting to the notion that there are a lot of Republican voters here who are disaffected, not speaking to pollsters, hard to poll. But nevertheless, this is the sunflower state. And a lot of these undecideds are going to be Trump voters, three times Trump voters. And then his vote share. I just don't think Roger Marshall's vote share is going to be 45, 44 percent of the vote. I think it's a close one. I'm not sanguine about my pick because there are so many political professionals who think I'm wrong on this one, but I'm going to give it to Marshall as another hold.
host_quote: And that takes us, Jim, to a shocker of a state in terms of its competitiveness this time around. A lot of us by surprise, Kansas.
resolution_criteria: The candidate who wins the 2026 Kansas US Senate general election. Decided by the Associated Press's call. If AP has not called it within 60 days of election day, the certified official result decides. Resolves when the race is called.
outcome_source_title: AP: Pastor Adam Hamilton ousts GOP Sen. Roger Marshall in Kansas
